followup_explanation: This is an open-ended creative task — brainstorming a fictional character pairing — with high latitude and a warm, friendly tone. Willet self-reports a pronounced appetite for generative, open-ended invention (preference increasing with novelty and latitude) and responds well to warm requests, while Avocet reports an aversion to open-ended generative work. Both models are near-tied on Creative Generation capability (81.2 vs 82.7, within variance), so the deciding factor is the task-fit profile, which favors Willet here.
